t: This is one hundred and sixteen to one hundred and nineteen Pall Mall, a Grade I listed building in the City of Westminster. Grade I is the highest level of listing, which tells you how important it's considered. It was designed by John Nash, the architect who gave London so many of its Georgian and Regency set pieces. His neoclassical and picturesque designs were financed by the Prince Regent and by the developer James Burton. Nash also worked extensively with Burton's son, Decimus Burton, on projects across the city.
